notes: verified means each post was read back from Buffer after creation, and its asset resolved to the expected dimensions (1600x900 and 1080x1350).

Asset URLs carry ?v=1. Buffer fetches an image when it is attached and keeps that copy, so republishing the same path with new bytes does not reach an already-scheduled post. Both files were confirmed byte-identical to the local renders before attaching: the Instagram one served a stale copy for several minutes after the deploy and was polled until it matched.
